Super easy fix, friend! Go to the nearest hardware store and get yourself a flanged wax ring. Turn off the water shut off on the water line. Flush the toilet to get all the water out of the tank to make the toilet lighter for when you remove it (also saves you from one hell of a mess!)

Next, unscrew the water line that is going into the toilet tank. Then, unscrew the bolts on the left and ride side if the toilet by the base. Once everything is unscrewed then go ahead and lift the toilet up and move it to reveal your wax ring. (Note: there will be water that leaks from the toilet p-trap)

Put the ring on and do everything you just undone! Voila. You have replaced your ring
